# APE Synthetic Expense Policy Amendment 2026

> Synthetic test document for RAG Builder regression testing only.
> This is NOT a real corporate amendment and must not be used for payroll or reimbursement advice.

## Part 1 — Commencement

### Section 1 — Effective Date

This synthetic amendment takes effect on **1 July 2026**.

Unless a provision states otherwise, meal-share changes apply only from that date.

---

## Part 2 — Amendment of meal reimbursement

### Section 5 — Amendment to meal reimbursement share

Section 10 of the **APE Synthetic Employee Expense Policy 2025** is amended.

From 1 July 2026, the meal reimbursement share is changed from **50% to 60% of the submitted receipt**.

The unique regression marker is: **APE-EXPENSE-MEAL-SHARE-2026 is 60 percent**.

The previous 50% share remains relevant only for historical questions relating to periods before 1 July 2026.

### Section 6 — Amendment to daily meal cap

Section 11 of the APE Synthetic Employee Expense Policy 2025 is amended.

From 1 July 2026, the daily meal cap is increased from **BDT 2,000 to BDT 2,500 per day**.

The unique regression marker is: **APE-EXPENSE-MEAL-CAP-2026 is BDT 2,500 per day**.

### Section 7 — Example after amendment

If the submitted meal receipt is **BDT 3,000**:

- Receipt amount: BDT 3,000
- Applicable share: 60%
- Meal reimbursement: **BDT 1,800**

The unique regression marker is: **APE-EXPENSE-MEAL-EXAMPLE-2026 reimbursement is BDT 1,800**.

The employee-provided receipt amount must be used directly.

The system must not substitute a different receipt amount.

---

## Part 3 — Travel class clarification

### Section 15 — Allowed travel class

Section 20 of the APE Synthetic Employee Expense Policy 2025 is not changed.

Approved business travel remains **economy class**.

The unique regression marker is: **APE-EXPENSE-TRAVEL-CLASS-2026 remains economy class**.
